name: s8_cat_crossing
description: Scenario 8: a cat runs across the road from the right-hand kerb at 3 m/s, on a collision course with the ego car (50 km/h). The cat starts so that it reaches the conflict point (the ego lane) at the same moment as the front of the car (trigger.arrivalOffsetS = 0). A cat is far smaller than a person (about 0.5 m long and 0.3 m high), so this tests the lower limit of what the lidar still resolves. The scripted driver does not react.
